full_page.content:
SAINT FELIX CAPUCHIN FRIARY HUNTINGTON, IND. November 22nd 1946
Blessed be God in His angels and in His Saints.
Dear Miss Panyard:
God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your practical "Loose leafs" just arrived this morning in perfect condition.
I hope to remember you someway in prayer as often as I shal use it.
God's blessing to all in the Lord.
Sincerely yours, Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
